brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Compartmentalized storage for small notions (buttons, pins, needles, bobbins)
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) and notch:0#1,1#notch2 hex-bin-notch-mf-div3 (3 compartments) provide divided storage; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) for secondary sorting

requirements.requirement: Larger open storage for fabric pieces / bigger sewing tools
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full (full depth, undivided) in piece:1,0,0;full provides bulk storage

requirements.requirement: Hanging/accessory storage for hand tools (scissors, tape measure, seam ripper)
requirements.evidence: accessory:0#0,0#1 and accessory:0#0,0#3 both hex-acc-hook plates on piece:0,0,0;full — each plate provides 2 hooks (4 hooks total) on exposed flats
accessory:0#0,0#2 hex-acc-rod (rod socket) on piece:0,0,0;full holds vertical dowel/rod for stacking thread spools
3 hex bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 linked by connector:0#0,0|0,1 and connector:0#0,0|1,0; check_build meshClash=clear, no errors, caps fitted to 7 exposed faces

finish.summary: Built a compact L-shaped 3-cell cluster for sewing supplies: 3-compartment and 2-compartment bins plus a matching 3-compartment notch bin in the 1,1 gap for sorted notions, a full-depth bin for larger fabric/tools, two hook plates (4 hooks) for scissors/tape and a rod socket for a thread-spool mast. All cells connected with side-connectors and open faces capped; configurator check passes meshClash=clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.
